lines.text: Israel must not fear a larger army, and the priest says the LORD goes with them to fight.
The officers send home men with an undedicated new house, an unenjoyed vineyard, or a pledged woman not yet married.
Officers appoint judges to lead the army, and a city that accepts peace opens its gates, its people forced laborers.
Israel must devote the Moabites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites to destruction, so they cannot teach Israel detestable things.
In a long siege Israel spares fruit trees but may cut trees known to bear no fruit for siege works.
